name: bottlerocket-sdk
description: Bottlerocket SDK (bottlerocket-os/bottlerocket-sdk): the toolchain and host tools AWS builds Bottlerocket with. Buildroot 2025.05.1 plus the SDK's five-patch series, x86_64 glibc. Not a firmware image: the build is a cross toolchain and sysroot.
notes: The SDK's defconfigs pin BR2_PRIMARY_SITE=file:///home/builder with BR2_PRIMARY_SITE_ONLY: its Dockerfile pre-fetches every source there. The fragment turns that off so Buildroot downloads normally. The SDK only ever runs `make toolchain`, never a full `make`: a full build also builds Buildroot's default init system and BusyBox, which fail against the SDK's own sysroot (`MB_LEN_MAX wrong` in the patched glibc headers), so the fragment selects no init system and no BusyBox and the build is what the SDK builds: the cross toolchain and sysroot (the root filesystem is the skeleton plus the target libc files). Buildroot is 2025.05.1 with patches/buildroot/0001-0005 applied at setup. Without BusyBox Buildroot would build dash as /bin/sh (also a target package that does not build against the SDK's sysroot), so the shell is none as well; a tar rootfs gives the manifest scanner something to read. native: three packages; the native skeleton recipe requires skeleton-init-sysv, and this configuration has no init system.
